title: Construct atomic models
action: Generate atomic coordinates for a pristine monolayer h-BN sheet (lattice constant 2.52 Å, B–N bond 1.45 Å) and at least six grain boundary configurations using the translation vectors (2,1)|(1,2), (3,2)|(2,3), (6,5)|(5,6) along zigzag and (1,9)|(9,1), (1,4)|(4,1), (2,5)|(5,2) along armchair. Models should have approximate dimensions 15 nm × 15 nm with periodic boundary conditions in‑plane and a 100 Å vacuum layer. Output LAMMPS data files.
description: Prepare all required atomic structures in LAMMPS data format.

title: MD relaxation
action: For each model, perform energy minimization, then equilibration at 300 K using an NPT ensemble for 50 ps followed by an NVT ensemble for 30 ps with a 1 fs timestep, using the Tersoff potential with parameters from Table 2.
description: Obtain stress‑free equilibrium structures for all models.

title: Baseline tensile test simulations
action: For each relaxed model, perform uniaxial tensile deformation at 300 K and a constant engineering strain rate of 1e8 s⁻¹. Apply load perpendicular to the grain boundary line. For the pristine sheet, test both zigzag and armchair directions. Record stress–strain data.
description: Run MD tensile tests that produce raw stress–strain curves.

title: Pristine mechanical properties
action: From the stress-strain curves of the pristine sheet obtained in step 03, extract Young's modulus (initial linear slope), ultimate tensile strength (peak stress), and critical failure strain (strain at catastrophic stress drop). Report one row for zigzag direction and one for armchair direction.
description: Scored artifact containing baseline mechanical properties of pristine h-BN.
output_schema: columns: direction (string: zz|am), Youngs_modulus_GPa (float), UTS_GPa (float), failure_strain_percent (float)

title: GB mechanical properties
action: From the stress-strain curves of the grain boundary models obtained in step 03, extract Young's modulus, ultimate tensile strength, and critical failure strain. Also, from the MD trajectories, identify the type of the first broken bond and record it. Write one row per model.
description: Scored artifact containing mechanical properties and fracture initiation bond type for the six grain boundary configurations.
output_schema: columns: model_name (string), direction (string: zz|am), GB_linear_density_nm-1 (float), Youngs_modulus_GPa (float), UTS_GPa (float), failure_strain_percent (float), first_broken_bond_type (string, e.g., 'B-N bond in hexagonal ring adjacent to (5|7) pair')

title: Strain‑rate tensile test simulations
action: For grain boundary models (2,1)|(1,2) and (1,9)|(9,1), perform tensile simulations at 300 K with strain rates of 1e8, 5e8, 1e9, 5e9, and 1e10 s⁻¹. Record stress–strain data.
description: Run MD simulations to capture the effect of strain rate on mechanical response.

title: Strain‑rate effects
action: For each strain‑rate simulation, extract ultimate tensile strength and Young's modulus. Report them organized by model and strain rate.
description: Scored artifact documenting the dependence of strength and modulus on strain rate.

title: Temperature‑dependent tensile test simulations
action: For grain boundary models (2,1)|(1,2) and (1,9)|(9,1), perform tensile simulations at a strain rate of 1e8 s⁻¹ and temperatures of 1, 300, 500, 800, and 1100 K. Record stress–strain data.
description: Run MD simulations to capture the effect of temperature on mechanical response.

title: Temperature effects
action: For each temperature‑dependent simulation, extract ultimate tensile strength and Young's modulus. Report them organized by model and temperature.
description: Scored artifact documenting the dependence of strength and modulus on temperature.
